title: Elastic Horizon: Discovering the Effective Interaction Frontier in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.07247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling the interaction horizon-the maximum number of environment interactions per episode-improves LLM agents on long-horizon tasks, and curriculum-based methods that progressively expand the horizon outperform fixed-horizon alternatives. However, existing schedules are open-loop: they monotonically increase the horizon until a manually specified maximum, with no mechanism to detect when further expansion stops helping. We propose the effective interaction frontier hypothesis: a dynamic boundary beyond which additional interactions yield diminishing returns while cost grows linearly. We then introduce Elastic Horizon, a closed-loop controller that tracks this boundary via the 90th percentile of successful trajectory lengths. translated_title: 弹性地平线：发现智能体强化学习中的有效交互边界
translated_abstract: 扩展交互视野（即每个回合内环境交互的最大次数）可以提升LLM智能体在长视野任务上的表现，而逐步扩展视野的基于课程的方法优于固定视野的替代方案。然而，现有的调度方案是开环的：它们单调地增加视野直到手动指定的最大值，缺乏检测进一步扩展何时不再有益的机制。我们提出了有效交互边界假设：存在一个动态边界，超过该边界后额外交互的收益递减，而成本线性增长。随后我们引入Elastic Horizon（弹性地平线），一种通过成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数来追踪该边界的闭环控制器。在AppWorld和BFCL数据集上，固定视野扫描显示出明显的饱和平台；Elastic Horizon无论从容量不足还是容量过剩的初始状态出发，都能将视野稳定在饱和带内，并取得了最佳的成……
tldr: 提出有效交互边界假设，并开发Elastic Horizon闭环控制器，通过成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数动态追踪该边界，将交互视野稳定在饱和带内，解决了现有开环视野扩展方法无法检测收益递减的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes the effective interaction frontier hypothesis and introduces Elastic Horizon, a closed-loop controller that tracks this dynamic boundary via the 90th percentile of successful trajectory lengths, stabilizing the horizon within the saturation band and addressing the inability of existing open-loop schedules to detect diminishing returns.
